name: Group_Fly
display_help: Aerobatics moderately increases your flight speed and provides a high amount of defense, flight protection, and additional flight control. If however, you are not flying, you will lose some of your Defense bonus. If you have also trained Fly, this power unlocks Group Fly, a power that endows your nearby teammates with Flight when active. While Aerobatics is active, Acrobatics and Weave will suppress. You must be at least level 14 and have two other Flight Powers before selecting Aerobatics.  This power only grants flight protection while Hover or Fly is active.
